metadata.purpose: Reviewed Stage A case split. Held-out store paraphrases stay frozen and are not used to choose ranks, weights, or synonyms.
metadata.builderPinNote: A measured run records its own commit, package version, and package digest. This file is the case list, not a live-worker report.

cases.note: Necessary Apple route stays discoverable; Android-only release is not required.
Retrieval must keep the #67 applicability language and must not reintroduce an unconditional quiz.
get() must deliver the artifact-contract DESIGN.md heading, not the first DESIGN.md specifier in catalog order.
A query that misses artifact-contracts lexically must still receive it as workflow_binding. Unscoped search must not return that reference or grow workflowCoverage.
A tight optional bundle stays incomplete; omitted or truncated entries stay visible.
A stale expectedContentSha256 must refuse. A matching hash must re-deliver the pinned artifact-contract DESIGN.md heading.
Hosted route-only callers do not receive a worker brief or a workspace-plan execution claim.
A second get of the pinned artifact-contract DESIGN.md heading is duplicated delivery, not a second unique required section.
